name: Amro Abdelgawad
biography: is a security researcher and the founder of Immuneye. He has more than 15 years experience in software security and reverse engineering. He has experienced both sides of software security in vulnerability researching, penetration testing, reverse engineering, exploit development and the defensive side as a chief security officer for software companies running wide infrastructures. Amro is currently working as a security researcher where his main interests are analyzing malware, vulnerability researching and developing artificial software immunity.
